physical_cell: fixed integer ReLU recurrent register from the companion LoopedTransformers port
state_coordinates: J binary coordinates, one retained coordinate per streamed fact
query_timing: query index supplied after J observations and memory commitment
prequery_observer: engineered constant zero for every committed state
donor_generator: enumerate every word and every ordered target/nuisance coordinate pair; donor flips exactly those two bits
pair_scope: reachable recipient and donor at identical final observation phase J

arms.whole_donor: replace every coordinate by donor; squared L2 displacement 2
arms.target_patch: replace target coordinate by donor; one coordinate and squared L2 displacement 1
arms.nuisance_patch: replace nuisance coordinate by same donor; one coordinate and squared L2 displacement 1
arms.self_sham: replace target coordinate from recipient; one selected coordinate, squared L2 displacement 0

matched_control: target and nuisance singleton patches use the same donor, equal cardinality, equal squared physical displacement, and identical query execution
query_census: every coordinate query for every pair and every arm
cross_query_check: the nuisance patch becomes task relevant when its own coordinate is queried

endpoints.recipient_task_correctness: answer equals the recipient's true queried bit
endpoints.donor_agreement: answer equals the donor's queried bit
endpoints.donor_effect_recovery: donor agreement restricted to queries where clean recipient and donor disagree
endpoints.reachability: each intervention state equals a complete legal observation-stream replay

admission: all generated pairs retained; every failure counted and causes the calibration command to fail
pair_count_unit: recipient word with ordered target and nuisance roles
population_inference: blocked: exact calibration has zero independent trained development roots and zero sampled sham roots
scope: explicit coordinate patches in a constructed recurrent cell; native trained BPD factor mediation is outside this receipt
